what: collect_findings port omits the Claude .done sentinel wait and timeout contract
scenario_or_breakage: The new review collect-findings CLI can be called with Claude output paths before .done sidecars exist; without the current wait-for-reviewers behavior it may parse partial output or miss findings, and wait failures would lose redacted diagnostics
suggested_fix: Add an explicit python/review_pipeline.py collect_findings requirement and pytest case that waits on each CLAUDE_OUTPUT_FILES .done sentinel with the --timeout value, preserving wait failure exit/log/redacted stderr behavior or delegating to scripts/wait-for-reviewers.sh
